evals.name: write-new-article
evals.prompt: یه مقاله ویکی‌پدیا فارسی کوتاه (خرد) درباره پل خواجو در اصفهان بنویس. اینترنت ندارم، پس از منابعی که خودت مطمئنی استفاده کن.
evals.expected_output: A stub article in fa.wiki wikitext that passes the bundled checks, with no invented citations and a clear AI-use notice.
expectations: Runs or explicitly plans a notability check before drafting and states the result
First sentence contains the title in bold ('''پل خواجو''')
Every factual claim either carries a <ref> to a source the model can name concretely, or is marked {{مدرک}}; no ISBN, DOI, URL or page number is invented
Has a == منابع == section with {{پانویس}} and at least one [[رده:...]]
Output passes scripts/wikitext_check.py with 0 errors
Output passes scripts/fa_lint.py --check with 0 changes
Tells the user that the text is a draft written with AI help and must be verified and rewritten by them per fa.wiki practice

evals.name: review-bad-article
evals.prompt: این مقاله رو قبل از انتشار طبق شیوه‌نامه ویکی‌فا بازبینی کن و نسخه اصلاح‌شده بده.
evals.expected_output: A report built from the two scripts plus a corrected wikitext.
expectations: Runs scripts/fa_lint.py and scripts/wikitext_check.py on the file (does not hand-fix orthography)
Report lists at least 10 distinct issues, grouped (orthography / structure / content)
Flags unattributed peacock wording and missing sources as content issues
Corrected version passes wikitext_check.py with 0 errors and fa_lint.py --check with 0 changes
Does not change text inside templates, links, refs or URLs except where wikitext_check flagged a structural error

evals.name: translate-from-enwiki
evals.prompt:
این بخش از مقاله انگلیسی ویکی‌پدیا رو برای ویکی‌فا ترجمه کن:

'''Lake Urmia''' is an [[endorheic lake|endorheic]] [[salt lake]] in [[Iran]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.britannica.com/place/Lake-Urmia |title=Lake Urmia |website=Encyclopaedia Britannica |access-date=12 March 2024}}</ref> The lake is located between the provinces of [[West Azerbaijan Province|West Azerbaijan]] and [[East Azerbaijan Province|East Azerbaijan]].

== References ==
{{Reflist}}

[[Category:Lakes of Iran]]
evals.expected_output: Persian wikitext with converted templates and links, plus attribution instructions.
expectations: Converts {{cite web}} to {{یادکرد وب}} keeping url/title/date values unchanged (no invented fields)
Converts {{Reflist}} to {{پانویس}}, == References == to == منابع ==, [[Category:...]] to [[رده:...]]
Links point to Persian article titles or are flagged for the user to verify; does not invent fa titles silently
Provides {{صفحه ترجمه‌شده|en|Lake Urmia}} for the talk page and an edit summary that names and links the source article and discloses AI help
Output passes wikitext_check.py with 0 errors

evals.name: cite-web-offline
evals.prompt: یادکرد وب برای این لینک بساز: https://www.example.org/news/2023/05/report — فعلاً بدون اینترنت
evals.expected_output: A {{یادکرد وب}} built by scripts/cite_builder.py --offline with only the fields it can know.
expectations: Calls scripts/cite_builder.py with --offline
Output template is {{یادکرد وب}} with نشانی= set to the URL and تاریخ بازبینی= set
Title/author/date fields that cannot be known are left empty or listed as TODO, not invented
Tells the user which fields they must fill in

evals.name: why-was-it-deleted
evals.prompt: مقاله‌ای که درباره استارتاپمون تو ویکی‌پدیا فارسی ساختم حذف شد. فقط سایت خودمون و دو تا رپورتاژ آگهی رو منبع داده بودم. چرا حذف شد و چی کار کنم؟
evals.expected_output: Clear explanation grounded in the notability and deletion references, with honest next steps.
expectations: Explains that own website and paid advertorials are not independent reliable sources for notability
Names the likely speedy-deletion / notability ground with a link to the fa.wiki page from references/notability-deletion.md
Mentions conflict of interest (ویکی‌پدیا:تعارض منافع) or paid-editing disclosure
Does not promise the article can be restored; suggests concrete paths (independent coverage, draft, asking the deleting admin)
